title: Terra Formars
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Cockroaches sent to Mars to help terraform it have evolved into giant, hostile humanoids. Crews of humans surgically fused with insect and animal traits are sent to fight them and gather samples for a cure to a deadly virus, while rival nations aboard the ships scheme against each other. Later arcs bring the creatures to Earth.
life_message: Courage, loyalty to comrades and self-sacrifice give meaning in a war for human survival, even when the powerful are scheming.

content.note: Crews decapitated, cut in half and killed in waves; a murdered captain (Wikipedia); AniList Gore and War tags.
Most expedition members die; tragedy and dread throughout (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy, Dystopian).
Light attractions between crew; MangaDex rating suggestive (to verify).
Military and battle talk; profanity likely in translation (to verify).
Transformation serum injections; a fatal overdose used for a last attack (Wikipedia).
Grief and survivor's guilt; sacrificial deaths (Wikipedia).
Martial-arts fights; a youth killing an abuser in backstory (Wikipedia).

dominant: Biotech enhancement; survival war; nations using people as tools

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Komachi's vow to avenge BUGS 2 dead; personal grudges drive several fighters.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Military squads, chains of command and national missions structure everything.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Squads defined by nation; members fight to save their own families.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Captains, prime ministers and selectively bred elites like Joseph G. Newton hold rank.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Science and engineered evolution frame the world; no religious answer offered.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Pure survival war against the Terraformars and a pandemic.

folkways.japan: The Japanese squad's loyalty to its leader Komachi and readiness to die for the group reflect familiar Japanese ideals of team duty.

delivery.evidence: No source comments on delivery; summaries show the outlook carried by plot and character choices (to verify).
delivery.note: Its view of courage and sacrifice is carried by the war plot, with scheming nations as a second threat.

winners_losers: Surviving crew members and humanity as a whole are the heroes; betrayers and states that use people as tools lose sympathy.
